title: Antibody-guided Chromatin Tagmentation for Two or More Factors (ACT2-seq)
protocol: Mix 4.5 μL of 2X CB + PI, 2 μL of 50 μM annealed complex adapter A, 2 μL of 50 μM annealed complex adapter B, and 2.5 μL of 1 μg/μL recombinant PA-Tn5 enzyme in a microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Label a set of microcentrifuge tubes for each antibody/PA-Tn5 complex combination.
Add 1.5 μL of the matching complex from step 1, 1.5 μL of 2X CB + PI, and 1.5 μL of the desired antibody to each tube.
Mix by pipetting and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Transfer 1 million cells to a clean 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge for 2 min at 500 *g.
Remove the supernatant and suspend the pellet in 1 mL of freshly prepared RIPA Buffer.
Incubate the tube at room temperature for 10 min.
Spin down the cells at 850 *g for 2 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant, leaving ~50 uL at the bottom to avoid loss of cells.
Suspend the cells in 1 mL of Wash Buffer.
Repeat the centrifugation and carefully remove the supernatant down to ~50 uL.
Suspend the cells in 1 mL of Wash Buffer.
If you started with fewer than ~1 million cells, make sure the final cell concentration is equivalent.
Label a 1.5 mL tube for each sample.
Transfer a 50 uL cell aliquot (~50 thousand cells) into each tube.
Add 4.5 uL of the matched AB-Tnp complexes from step 2 to each tube.
Mix each sample by pipetting gently.
Incubate the samples at room temperature for 30 min.
Add 1 mL of Wash Buffer to each tube.
Rotate the tubes for 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the cells at 850 *g
Remove the supernatant, leaving ~50 μL at the bottom to avoid loss of cells.
Add 3 μL of 50 uM annealed blocking adapter to the sample and mix by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Add 4.5 μL of the next AB-Tnp complex to each sample and mix by pipetting gently.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
If probing more than two marks per sample, repeat steps 9 through 11 for each remaining complex.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer to each tube and rotate the tubes for 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the cells at 850 *g and remove the supernatant down to ~50 μL.
Repeat step 13.
Dilute the samples to ~100 uL with Wash Buffer using the volume markings on the sides of the tubes.
Add 1.5 μL of 1 M MgCl₂ to each tube of cells and gently suspend the cells by pipetting.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 60 min to allow targeted tagmentation to occur.
Stop the reactions by adding 8 μL of 0.5 M EDTA.
Vortex thoroughly to mix.
Incubate samples at 80 °C for 5 min.
Add 2 μL of 10% SDS.
Add 1 μL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K.
Incubate at 55 °C for 60 min.
Purify the DNA using a MinElute PCR Purification kit and an elution volume of 20 μL.
Transfer each ~20 μL sample to a PCR tube.
Add 0.5 μL of 50 μM PCR adapter #1 to each sample.
Add 0.5 μL of 50 μM PCR adapter #2 to each sample.
Add 20 μL of 2X NEB Phusion HF Master Mix to each sample.
Mix by pipetting.
Amplify using the following program: 72 °C for 5 min, 98 °C for 10 s, 65 °C for 30 s (15 to 17 cycles), 72 °C for 15 s, 72 °C for 5 min.
Visualize the PCR products using gel electrophoresis on a 2% E-gel run for 20 min.
Excise gel slices corresponding to DNA fragment sizes between ~250 to 800 bp.
Purify the PCR products using a MinElute Gel Purification Kit (or equivalent).
Quantify the purified DNA libraries.
Multiplex the DNA libraries as required.
Sequence the multiplexed DNA libraries.
